audit.why: Level 1-5 and first item favour Thresh (19s-CD Death Sentence outranges Poppy's 430-range Hammer Shock); 2+ items favours Poppy once W/E/R answer the dive. Content win[] already states this split correctly.
Spikes at level 2-3 (hook-Flay chain), level 6 (The Box layering), and 2+ items (Poppy's anti-dive kit comes online) are already named in breakdown.spikes and the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart's full-layer side was left at the unfilled 'Skill' placeholder on all 7 rows even though content win[] already resolved the same rows to Thresh (1-6) / Poppy (7). The R-vs-Q channel-cancel interaction (Thresh's Death Sentence interrupts Keeper's Verdict) was never stated.
audit.why: phases[N].side must agree with content win[N] on the same row (THE CHART RULE). Death Sentence is a hard-CC hook (19/16.5/14/11.5/9s CD) that cancels Poppy's channelled R outright — a missingInteractions-flagged, matchup-defining fact absent from breakdown.cooldowns.
audit.corrected: phases[0-5].side -> 'Thresh', phases[6].side -> 'Poppy' (matching win[]); breakdown.cooldowns now states the R-cancels-on-Q interaction.

edits.before: Q the contacts — the hammer chunk is honest and the passive shield toss annoys.
edits.after: Death Sentence outranges Hammer Shock — respect the hook before you show for trades.

edits.before: W governs dashes already — their mobility kit just lost its lane privileges.
edits.after: Death Sentence still outranges your kit — Flay punishes any step past minions.

edits.before: Full kit: E the wall-adjacent and Q the pinned — the lane's geometry is a weapon.
edits.after: Full kit lands, but Death Sentence still opens it — check Q before E-ing off walls.

edits.before: Zone with W threat — engage supports pay a no-dash tax to play.
edits.after: Hook range dictates engages — zone behind minions until his Q whiffs.

edits.before: Keeper's Verdict online — the dive that survives everything still flies home.
edits.after: The Box layers with hook-Flay CC — his pick threat still outranges your all-in.

edits.before: First item: the pins chunk and the W deletes engage comps.
edits.after: First item: hook tempo leads — play safe until his Q is down.

edits.before: - Thresh Death Sentence: matchup-defining — The hook starts the lantern chain — dodge it and the playbook waits 19 seconds. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Steadfast Presence answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Thresh Death Sentence: matchup-defining — dodge it and the playbook waits 19 seconds. Read it before every duo step-up. - Death Sentence also cancels your R mid-channel — only cast Keeper's Verdict once his Q lands or its 19s cooldown starts.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence grounds any diver's dash the instant Death Sentence lands — save it for the follow-up.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: His lantern peel and Flay disengage punish a walk-up E — wait until Death Sentence is on cooldown.

notes: The 'shield-absorbs-burst' missing interaction (Thresh's Dark Passage lantern shield soaking your all-in burst) and the 'knockup-enabler' one (Keeper's Verdict vs Death Sentence, whoever lands first owns the trade) are both real per the kits but there was no safe slot to fold them in without exceeding the ±10% band or duplicating an existing sentence — flagging for a future pass. Packet defect 'level chart contradicts data' is resolved by this proposal's side flips, which now match content win[] and the packet's own levelChart (Thresh 6/7, Poppy on 2+ items), consistent with the 52.38% overall Poppy winrate (early-game deficit, late-game favour).
